name: bd-train-tracker
description: RailKhoj — live Bangladesh Railway train tracking (schedule engine + community reports)

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --include=dev --prefix web --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix web
